title: GLM-5.4 Quietly Launches Coding Plan: Fills In Vision Capabilities, Quota Also Up 1.5x
excerpt: Zhipu's GLM-5.4 made its entrance before any official launch event. Zhipu's official operations staff announced that the GLM-5.4 model is now available on Codin
content_html:
Zhipu's GLM-5.4 made its entrance before any official launch event. Zhipu's official operations staff announced that the GLM-5.4 model is now available on Coding Plan; users can call it directly by setting the model name to glm-5.4. Usage quotas for V2, V3, and Team Edition users have also been increased to 1.5x. Detailed information about this new model has not yet been released, but two key tags can already be seen in the Coding Plan model list: "1M" and "Vision".

The official teaser revealed two new strengths: newly added vision capabilities and stronger general coding abilities. This means coding agents can not only read code, but also "understand" screenshots, interfaces, and diagrams, digesting an entire codebase within a context as long as one million tokens. The groundwork laid over the past three months also finds its footnote in this news—the Zhipu team said they are aggressively advancing both Scaling Loop and model size, and that "the first thing everyone will see is the surprise brought by Loop Transformer." The quietly launched GLM-5.4 may be the first answer to that surprise, while a fuller official introduction remains to be revealed.
